title: File:Flat earth.png
artist: Trekky0623 at English Wikipedia ("I made this map myself")
description: An azimuthal equidistant projection of the entire spherical Earth. A rendered picture of the Flat Earth model. The white around the outside of the globe is thought to be an 'Ice Wall', some people say that the next thing we would encounter after the Ice Wall is the dome wall, the dome being the encasing that encloses the whole earth.
